subject.title: feat: generic session discussion seam with Control UI panel

question: Should OpenClaw commit to a public, process-wide `session-discussion` plugin SDK and gateway protocol seam now, rather than keep this capability in the prospective discussion-provider plugin until broader reuse is established?
rationale: The PR adds a new public plugin API, protocol methods, generated client models, and a singleton ownership model; choosing whether that permanent core contract should exist requires maintainer product and API-direction judgment.

options.title: Sponsor the generic seam
options.body: Keep the public SDK and gateway contract, but require transactional provider lifecycle handling before merge.

options.title: Keep it provider-local for now
options.body: Move the discussion integration into the provider/plugin until multiple independent integrations demonstrate the need for a shared core seam.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the generic seam
recommendation.body: Keep the public SDK and gateway contract, but require transactional provider lifecycle handling before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history shows direct ownership of the proposed API, gateway, and Control UI design.
